decontamination_notes: cii-v2 candidate #2 under the frontier admission gate, chosen to match the profile of the suite's only frontier-resistant task (wide convention-rich contract, corners not derivable from first principles, no brute-force oracle possible): zod #6419 'refine optin into a three-rung ladder' (merged 2026-08-17, six days before task creation), fixing #6321 — a regression where .default() was lost when a .transform() followed it under .optional()/.partial(). Upstream's own first fix attempt (#6329) was superseded as structurally wrong, which is direct evidence the fix is easy to get subtly incorrect. The trap texture: the correct fix must make optional wrappers DELEGATE for schemas carrying a default while still SHORT-CIRCUITING undefined for schemas whose undefined-acceptance comes from preprocess/catch/bare transforms (the #5941/#5939 clobber invariants) — the two requirements point in opposite directions, so an over-broad fix breaks the guards and a narrow special-case likely misses prefault/async/union/lazy variants. Built by differential probing: 42 optionality corners executed at base and gold in the task image; exactly 5 diverge (the #6321 family: default/prefault + transform under optional/partial, sync and async) and 36 are stable. The 5 divergent behaviors form the 4 fail_to_pass tests; the 36 stable ones are pinned across 7 guards (key admissibility, tuple rungs, clobber short-circuits, wrapper orders, record/catchall, exactOptional/pipe/partial/required, async parity). Base is the direct parent of the squash-merge; gold is the PR's four source files (classic/schemas.ts, core/schemas.ts, core/util.ts, core/json-schema-processors.ts), tests and wiki excluded. Upstream's in-repo vitest tests remain in the slice at their BASE versions (some encode the pre-fix expectations upstream itself had to update — realistic, and hidden tests define truth). Per the v2 charter: no fix-location hints (agent_hints carries budgets only), issue states symptoms plus two must-not-change examples, never files, mechanisms, or the ladder design. Internal _zod.optin rung values are deliberately NOT asserted anywhere so any correct public behavior passes. Assertions check parse results only, never error message text.
